questions.label: Personal data collected
questions.ask: Which personal data does the product collect about the people who use it?
options: Account details (name, email, password or SSO identity)
Billing details (handled by a payment processor)
Device and usage data (IP address, browser, pages used)
questions.codebase: User and account schemas, signup forms, auth provider, payment SDK, file upload handlers.

questions.label: Analytics and tracking
questions.ask: Which tracking tools run on the website or in the product?
options: Product analytics (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics)
questions.fills: Privacy: Information We Collect and Cookies sections
questions.codebase: Analytics, pixel and monitoring SDK initialization in client and server code, script tags in the root layout.

questions.label: Selling or sharing for ads
questions.ask: Do you sell personal data, or share it with others for their advertising?
options: We use ad pixels that share data with ad networks
questions.fills: Privacy: How We Share Information, US state privacy rights
questions.codebase: Advertising pixels (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn Insight, TikTok) in page markup.

questions.label: Marketing email
questions.ask: Which emails do you send to users?
options: Product emails plus marketing with an unsubscribe link
questions.fills: Privacy: How We Use Information, choices section
questions.codebase: Email provider SDK (Resend, Postmark, SendGrid, Customer.io, Loops) and the templates it sends.

questions.label: Account data retention
questions.ask: After someone deletes their account, how long until their personal data is deleted from live systems?
questions.fills: Privacy: How Long We Keep Information (backups follow backup-retention)
questions.codebase: Account deletion handlers, soft-delete columns and purge jobs.

questions.label: Privacy requests
questions.ask: How can people access, correct, export or delete their data?
options: Self-service in account settings, plus email
Through their employer's admin, plus email
questions.fills: Privacy: Your Rights, and how requests are answered
questions.codebase: Account settings pages with delete or export actions.

questions.label: Minimum age
questions.ask: What is the minimum age to use the product?

questions.label: Where data is stored
questions.ask: Where is personal data stored and processed?
questions.codebase: Hosting and database regions in infrastructure config (vercel.json, fly.toml, Terraform, wrangler.toml, Supabase or Neon project region).
